eyepatch.what: A recurring memory device — one golfer / one club / one shot / one simple verdict / one Swing Shack frame.
eyepatch.why: The Hathaway eyepatch worked because it made an ordinary category instantly distinctive. Swing Shack needs a repeatable memory device, not a fresh creative invention every week.

one_pager.who_are_we: Johannesburg's golf improvement club for people who care about their game but still want to enjoy it.
one_pager.ambition: Be the brand that knows more about the serious golfer's actual swing than anyone else in South Africa.
one_pager.purpose: Do everything we can to make golf more enjoyable.
one_pager.belief: Golf is more fun when it makes sense.
one_pager.distinctive: 'What Does Your Swing Say?' + The 10-Ball Truth + human Shack Sessions.
one_pager.consistency: A visible year → quarter → month → week → post map, planned at least three weeks ahead, supported by reusable graphic layouts and designed video intros/outros.
one_pager.what_we_sell: Better understanding, better decisions, more confidence and more enjoyable golf.
one_pager.what_we_refuse_to_become: A clinical lab, a simulator rental venue, or a feed full of disconnected golf posts.
